name: bollinger_ema_sar_v5_band_correction
purpose: Implement the user's correction: do not enter LONG because a 3/9 bullish cross happened while price is high; wait for price to correct to the lower Bollinger band, and vice versa for SHORT. Keep the first-test 40% Bollinger / max-3-bar exit.

structure.long: Prior bar sweeps below latest confirmed swing low; signal bar has higher low and closes back above the swept level.
structure.short: Prior bar sweeps above latest confirmed swing high; signal bar has lower high and closes back below the swept level.

market_regime_filter.rule: Use V2 fixed EMA20 net-slope filter: 5-bar directional EMA20 move must be at least 5% of current Bollinger bandwidth.

bollinger_location.long: Signal candle itself must touch or pierce LOWER Bollinger band: low <= lower band.
bollinger_location.short: Signal candle itself must touch or pierce UPPER Bollinger band: high >= upper band.

ema3_9_state.long: Fresh cross on signal bar is not required. EMA3 must be above EMA9 at signal close. A prior bullish 3/9 cross may occur earlier; entry waits for the lower-band correction setup.
ema3_9_state.short: Fresh cross on signal bar is not required. EMA3 must be below EMA9 at signal close. A prior bearish 3/9 cross may occur earlier; entry waits for the upper-band correction setup.
ema3_9_state.diagnostic: Record bars since the most recent matching 3/9 cross; do not use cross age as a gate.

signal_candle.rocket_long: Green body with lower wick >=70% of body.
signal_candle.rocket_short: Red body with upper wick >=70% of body.
signal_candle.engulfing: Body fully engulfs the previous candle body in trade direction.

entry.execution: Open of next bar after fully closed signal candle

stop.long: Low of candle immediately before signal candle
stop.short: High of candle immediately before signal candle

exit.target: 40% of Bollinger bandwidth measured at signal close, projected from entry
exit.time_exit: Close of third entry bar if target or stop did not hit

session_rule: NY anchor 09:00-12:00 ET remains contextual only; no hard time restriction.
comparison: Compare V5 with V1/V2 on sample size, expectancy, PF, drawdown, direction, session, pattern, exit reason, filter funnel and cross-age distribution. Discovery only; no live promotion.
